value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER. A high fever with a severe headache, a stiff painful neck and light hurting the eyes has to be checked by a doctor right away, because early treatment matters.
value.triage: Go to the ER now or call 911 - do not wait at home. Call 911 if they are hard to wake, confused, floppy, vomiting, having a seizure, or have a rash that does not fade when pressed. 811 is for nurse advice, but do not wait for a callback.
